prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look (ignore its labels, they are not part of the picture). "Quantum-Labor", a high-tech secret research laboratory deep inside a glass corporate tower, interior seen from above, cut-away walls on the top edge only, floor fills most of the image: glossy white floor tiles with thin cyan light seams, a large open, calm walkable area in the middle.
TOP WALL from left to right: a steel elevator door with a glowing cyan frame (top left); white wall panels with glowing data screens (abstract waves, no text); TOP CENTER, the most eye-catching spot: a huge central mainframe computer protruding into the room, a block of black glass server towers with a big curved screen showing an abstract glowing face-like pattern in cyan and violet, thick cables running into the floor; to its right a long armoured glass window looking down into a dark shaft with a glowing core far below; TOP RIGHT corner: a heavy round vault door with a big wheel like a submarine hatch, yellow-black hazard stripes around it.
LEFT WALL: a steel chip vault cabinet with a round combination dial and a small glowing keypad (top-left, below the elevator); a large ventilation grille in the left wall with a short steel ladder; lower left a row of server racks with blinking LEDs.
CENTER: a futuristic operating table with a big round surgical lamp and two white robotic arms; to its right a reclined patient chair with padded restraints and a headset full of wires; left of center a long white lab bench with microscopes and glass vials; a small yellow-black striped pillar with a big red emergency stop button near the top wall.
BOTTOM LEFT: a cluttered hacker desk against the bottom wall with three monitors, a messy keyboard, energy drink cans and stickers, a rolling chair.
RIGHT SIDE: a sleek white standing console with floating holographic panels (no text). RIGHT WALL: a heavy grey security door with a red warning lamp above it.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a precision workbench against the bottom wall with a magnifier lamp, tiny tweezers and screwdrivers laid out in neat rows, tiny circuit boards.
BOTTOM CENTER: a white sliding lab door in the bottom wall (the way to the corridor).
Small stuff at the edges only: cable trays, a water cooler, a potted plastic plant, a trolley with instruments, a waste bin with a biohazard symbol (symbol only).
Light: night, indoor, cold clean white light from ceiling panels, cyan glow from screens, violet accents, deep blue shadows in the corners. Clean, sterile, expensive, slightly sinister.
